title: SPECIAL RULES FOR PARKING FACILITIES WITHIN THE LONG ISLAND CITY AREA
previewText: All accessory off-street parking facilities, public parking lots and public parking garages developed or enlarged after October 25, 1995, in the Long Island City area shall comply with the applicable provisions of this Section, inclusive.
